answer: Juries draw from three different subnets, and attestations arriving from one subnet get taxed 60 percent, so the cause is cheap to see and the effect is that a self-hosted cluster pays more to say less. What breaks first is the solo operator on one home connection, which is why the tax should apply to the group's weight and not to a first submission. A yarrow patch on one river of shared hosting gets taxed once, not per person, and the kernel stays fair.
